game.title: Pokémon FireRed
game.revision_note: US FireRed v1.0 and v1.1 use different memory addresses — codes are NOT interchangeable between revisions. Most cartridges and common ROM dumps are v1.0.

codes.name: Master Code (v1.0)
codes.description: Master code for FireRed US v1.0 ('(m) - Must Be On'). Add it in Delta as its own cheat and enable it before other GameShark v3 / Action Replay codes.

codes.name: Master Code (v1.1)
codes.description: Master code for FireRed US v1.1 ('(M) Must Be On'). Add as its own cheat and enable it before other v1.1 GameShark v3 / Action Replay codes.

codes.name: Anti-DMA (v1.1, enable with item cheats)
codes.description: Anti-DMA enabler for v1.1. Enter as a separate cheat and enable it together with the v1.1 Master Code before using v1.1 item-in-PC codes.

codes.name: Walk Through Walls (v1.0)
codes.description: Walk through walls. The source's hand-tested v1.0 entry doesn't list a master code, but enabling one is harmless, so it's marked required here.
side_effects: Check your bag after activating any cheat — if you notice irregularities, do NOT save.
Turn the cheat off after use.

codes.name: Walk Through Walls (v1.1)
codes.description: Walk through walls for FireRed ROM v1.1.
side_effects: Turn the cheat off after use.

codes.name: Unlimited Rare Candy in PC (v1.0)
codes.description: Puts unlimited Rare Candies in PC item storage. Withdraw at any Pokémon Center PC.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw Item
side_effects: Uses the same PC slot address as the Master Ball PC code — enable only one of them at a time.

codes.name: 99x Rare Candies in PC (v1.1)
codes.description: 99 Rare Candies via PC for v1.1. Enable the v1.1 Master Code AND the Anti-DMA code (both as separate cheats) first, then withdraw at a Pokémon Center PC.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw Item
side_effects: Also requires the Anti-DMA code to be enabled — item cheats may silently fail without it.
If the item doesn't appear, go in and out of a door a few times and check the PC again.

codes.name: Unlimited Master Ball in PC (v1.0)
codes.description: Puts unlimited Master Balls in PC item storage. Withdraw at any Pokémon Center PC.
codes.activation: Pokémon Center PC → Item Storage → Withdraw Item
side_effects: Uses the same PC slot address as the Rare Candy PC code — enable only one of them at a time.

codes.name: Money section Master Code (v1.0)
codes.description: Master code the source lists specifically alongside its money codes. Add as its own cheat and enable it with the money cheats.

codes.name: Instant 999,999 Money (v1.0)
codes.description: Sets money to 999,999. The source lists its money-section master code immediately before this one; enable that master code with it.

codes.name: Infinite Money
codes.description: Infinite money. Listed identically for both v1.0 and v1.1 — pair it with the master code matching YOUR revision (v1.1 users: enable the v1.1 Master Code instead).

codes.name: Shiny Wild Pokémon (v1.0)
codes.description: Forces wild Pokémon to be shiny while keeping stats, gender, and abilities unchanged.
side_effects: Avoid breeding Pokémon caught with shiny cheats — it can cause glitches.
Mixed reports: some players saw no shinies or freezes; use English FireRed v1.0 and restart the emulator if it fails.

codes.name: EXP section Master Code (v1.0)
codes.description: Master block the source requires specifically for the Infinite EXP cheat. Add as its own cheat; the source says to ignore any 'cheat may not be applied' alert.

codes.name: Infinite EXP (v1.0)
codes.description: Infinite EXP gain. Requires the EXP section master code entered first as a separate cheat.
codes.activation: Enable when EXP is being awarded; disable to stop leveling
side_effects: Must be toggled — leaving it on keeps leveling your Pokémon.
